prompt: Modern buildings appear in large numbers, but some people believe that we should build our buildings in traditional styles. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is a controversy among citizens about the theme of buildings, traditional or modern style. In my opinion, I largely prefer the modern style as a better lifestyle provider for people to live. I will discuss both points of view and why I prefer new urban styles.

To begin with, Modern buildings include many advantages that make the life of their citizens easier. New buildings covered  a very small area of land because  buildings are built  vertically rather than horizontally, this structure  can carry more people in the same piece of land. This makes it easier for the governments to provide water and electricity supplies for all  people at a low cost. For instance, cities like Shanghai and Dubia known for their tall skyscrapers, have  more population in a small area than other  countries.

Moreover, traditional homes have their own concept and theme, but with many disadvantages that struggles development process of urban civilisations. One of the main disadvantages is transportation, which takes way too long distances because of the huge area that  traditional buildings take. Also, another obstacle is facilities, governments need to provide more hospitals, schools and parks  because of the large piece of land it takes to cover people’s needs. For example,  Cairo is one of the biggest population cities  that faces daily transportation difficulties due to its huge, scattered area; any  day trip is a whole journey.

In conclusion, I firmly prefer modern building concepts because of  the benefits they deliver to urbanisation. Traditional buildings are good for tourism, they also give the place a cultural identity, but the disadvantages are more than the advantages.
